text.card: A red giant 1,016 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.30 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,845 K at its surface.
